'''0.11b''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that added the [[Chemical Plant]] [[Locations|location]] and included a "God Rays" effect.

==Changelog==
* Added level [[Chemical Plant]]
* Included "God Rays" effect
* Disabled parallax mapping on low settings
* Optimized for low shader settings
* After the death the character reloads and does not change weapon
* Prohibits the use of internal console commands
